correctness.rationale: Strict convexity and symmetry reduce to one interior root. Direct differentiation and an explicitly verified antiderivative give B_h(q); true interval calculations certify four strict centroid signs. Continuity yields a non-equilateral coincidence; threefold symmetry gives the equilateral coincidence; exact derivative proves transversality. Uniform small/large shape expansions follow from the exact B formula. Direct independent quadrature checks are corroboration, not substitute for analytic proof.

value.rationale: The result supplies a motivated counterexample to centroid-equality rigidity for a natural continuous facility-location center, with two verifiable changes in center order and sharp opposite-degeneration asymptotics. Its value rests on the geometric counterexample and structure, not merely numeric optimization or novelty search.
